_excluded.statement: Fixed dose combination of Ofloxacin + Ornidazole INJECTION.
_excluded.exclusion_reason: FORM-SCOPED. The prohibition covers the injectable form only. Phase-A dry run: 36 of 36 matches were oral products (Oflox OZ Tablet, Orni-O Tablet, Zanocin OZ Tablet, O2 Tablet, one Oflox OZ Suspension), independently corroborated by the orchestrator against db13 — 14 distinct name/dosage variants, all oral, dosed 1-0-1, zero injections. The matcher is molecule-set-only with no dosage-form awareness, so including this entry would assert illegality against a legal oral FDC in every single case. Re-admit only after form/route scoping exists in both the seed schema and the matcher.
